headline: Names a Postal Service building in Princeton, Florida, after Corporal Christian A. Guzman Rivera.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 13500 SW 250 Street in Princeton, Florida. The building is now officially called the "Corporal Christian A. Guzman Rivera Post Office Building." It does not change how the post office operates or any mail services.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2014.
